mandate: Pure-Software ISA-18.2 First-Out Alarm Annunciator & Multi-Client Concurrency Audit

invariant_A_first_out_discrimination.description: Root-cause Point 1 identified as FirstOutId=1 in cascading outage (Points 2, 4, 7)

invariant_B_flasher_discrimination.description: Fast flash toggled 4x (2.0 Hz) vs slow flash 2x (1.0 Hz)

invariant_C_horn_and_acknowledge.description: Horn silenced and beacon steady-on upon operator acknowledgment

invariant_D_failsafe_reset_interlock.description: Reset interlock clears points only when field condition is normal; FirstOutId resets when 100% clear

invariant_E_lamp_horn_test.description: Lamp test illuminates all 8 beacons and horn without clearing unack/latched state
